Northern Tulcea warned after target detected in Ukrainian airspace

13 November 2026 · Northern Tulcea · 13 November aerial-target warning

MApN-reported nearby target; drone identity and Romanian entry not established

Romanian authorities issued a warning for northern Tulcea on 13 November 2026 after radar detected an aerial target southeast of Snake Island in Ukrainian airspace.

Two Romanian F-16s launched from Fetești. The warning ran from 21:53 to 22:58 local time; these are warning times, not a verified flight duration.

The reviewed ministry account did not identify the target as a drone or establish Romanian entry. This is a selected alert, not a confirmed incursion or attack.
